svg.title: Ila refuses an off-frame contractor's completion certificate while Vale waits.
svg.desc: An unnamed contractor's hand offers a blank certificate from outside the frame. Ila does not take it and says an inspection should be harmless if this is merely paperwork; Vale watches without taking the decision from her.
svg.text: Page 31, panel 4 · Compressed two-shot with the contractor kept outside the speaking frame

text.tspan: The politically connected contractor asks Ila to
treat the mismatch as paperwork and settle it

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
